```{r Standard Setup}
# Configure directories, load libraries and base functions
source(paste0(here::here(), "/0-config.R"))

directory = paste0(here(), "/3-figures/")

##### FIX THIS LATER ##### 
sample_file_path <- "/Users/bfu/Dropbox/Group_projects/Capsule-Gen2-LONGIT-Wk/LONGIT-Weeklong_SampleSheet_FINAL.xlsx"

kits <- read_excel(sample_file_path, sheet = 1)
samples <- read_excel(sample_file_path, sheet = 2)
##### FIX THIS LATER ##### 

output <- setup_tables(paste0(here(), "/1-data/DADA2-Weeklong/"), '/1-data/Capscan-weeklong-sample-info.xlsx')
ps <- output$ps # phyloseq object
taxa_order <- output$taxa_order # ASV plot order
samdf <- output$samdf # sample information
samdf$Sample <- rownames(samdf)

total_reads <- as.data.frame(sample_sums(ps)) # get total number of reads
colnames(total_reads) <- "total_reads"
total_reads$Sample <- rownames(total_reads)

# Add read counts and sample info
samdf <- samdf %>%
  left_join(total_reads, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(total_reads = ifelse(is.na(total_reads), 0, total_reads)) %>%
  left_join(samples, by = "Sample_ID")

# update samdf of phyloseq
rownames(samdf) <- sub('sample_', '', samdf$Sample) # change row names to be the sequencing name, remove "sample_"
samdf <- samdf %>%
  select(-Sample) 
sample_data(ps) <- sample_data(samdf)

#######################################
# Variables to change
#######################################

set_ordered_factors <- function(df2plot) {
  # Set default ordered factors in dataframe
  df2plot <- df2plot %>%
      mutate(Region = factor(Region, levels = c("NA", "Saliva", "R1", "R2", "R3", "Stool"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(Sample_origin = factor(Sample_origin, levels = c("Capscan0", "Capscan1", "Capscan2", "Capscan3", "Capscan3E", "Capscan4", "Capscan4E", "Capscan5", "Capscan5E", "Capscan6", "Capscan6E", "Capscan7", "Capscan8", "CapscanExtra1", "CapscanExtra2", "CapscanExtra3", "ExtraSaliva", "Saliva0", "Saliva1", "Saliva2", "Saliva3", "Saliva3E", "Saliva4", "Saliva4E", "Saliva5", "Saliva5E", "Saliva6", "Saliva6E", "Saliva7", "Saliva8", "Stool0", "Stool1", "Stool2", "Stool3", "Stool3E", "Stool4", "Stool5", "Stool5E", "Stool6", "Stool6E", "Stool7", "Stool8", "StoolExtra1", "StoolExtra2", "StoolNoCapscan"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(Sample_origin2 = factor(Sample_origin2, levels = c("Cap0", "Cap1", "Cap2", "Cap3", "CapE1", "Cap4", "Cap5", "CapE2", "Cap6", "Cap7", "Cap8", "CapEx1", "CapEx2", "CapEx3", "SalivaX", "Saliva0", "Saliva1", "Saliva2", "Saliva3", "Saliva3E", "Saliva4", "Saliva4E", "Saliva5", "Saliva5E", "Saliva6", "Saliva6E", "Saliva7", "Saliva8", "Stool0", "Stool1", "Stool2", "Stool3", "Stool3E", "Stool4", "Stool5", "Stool5E", "Stool6", "Stool6E", "Stool7", "Stool8", "StoolExtra1", "StoolExtra2", "StoolNoCapscan"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(Sample_origin3 = factor(Sample_origin3, levels = c("Saliva", "Capscan", "Stool"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(Kit_set = factor(Kit_set, levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3E", "3", "4E", "4", "5E", "5", "6E", "6", "7", "8", "Extra")))
  df2plot$total_reads <- factor(df2plot$total_reads)
  return(df2plot)
}

cutoff_SI <- 0.001 # Supplementary Info ASV cutoff
cutoff_MT <- 0.01 # Main Text ASV cutoff (to minimize legend)
```

#######################################
# Sequencer statistics
#######################################

```{r Sequencer stats}
num_zeros <- sum(samdf$total_reads == 0)
num_samples <- sum(samdf$total_reads >= 0)

g <- ggplot(samdf, aes(x = log10(total_reads), fill = Region)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_origin) +
  scale_x_continuous("log10(reads)", limits = c(0, NA), breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)) +
  labs(x = "log10(reads)", y = "Counts", subtitle = paste0(num_zeros, " of ", num_samples, " samples have 0 reads.")) + 
  ggtitle("Read distribution") +
  theme_custom_text() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),  # Legend text size
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Sequencer/Read-counts-region.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 4, height = 4)

g <- ggplot(samdf, aes(x = log10(total_reads), fill = Region)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~Subject_ID, ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_origin) +
  scale_x_continuous("log10(reads)", limits = c(0, NA), breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)) +
  labs(x = "log10(reads)", y = "Counts", subtitle = paste0(num_zeros, " of ", num_samples, " samples have 0 reads.")) + 
  ggtitle("Read distribution") +
  theme_custom_text() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),  # Legend text size
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Sequencer/Read-counts-region-subject.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 5, height = 8)
```

```{r Composition - by sample_origin}

ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(Region == "Saliva")

taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
    filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT)
  
ps2plot <- prune_taxa(taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot) %>%  # keep ASVs in taxa2keep
    transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # renomalize
  
df2plot <- psmelt(ps2plot) # convert to long form
df2plot <- set_family_order(df2plot, taxa_order) # set Family2 order
df2plot <- set_ordered_factors(df2plot) # set ordered factors
  
family2_scale <- get_color_mapping(df2plot) # legend colors

for (sid in unique(samdf$Subject_ID)) {
  
    g <- ggplot(df2plot %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid), aes(x = 1, y = Abundance, fill = Family2)) + 
         geom_bar(aes(x = total_reads), position = "stack", stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) + 
         scale_y_continuous("Relative Abundance", breaks = c(0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00)) +
         scale_x_discrete(labels = red_if_small_discrete) +
         scale_fill_manual(values = family2_scale$values, breaks = family2_scale$breaks, labels = family2_scale$labels) +
         facet_nested(cols = vars(Collection_date, Collection_time, Sample_origin2), scales = "free", space = "free") +
         theme_custom_comp() +
         theme(axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
        
    ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-composition-0p01/Saliva-collection/Composition-saliva-", sid, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 0.5*length(unique(df2plot %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid) %>% pull(No))) + 1, height = 4)
}

g <- ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = 1, y = Abundance, fill = Family2)) + 
     geom_bar(aes(x = 1), position = "stack", stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) + 
     scale_y_continuous("Relative Abundance", breaks = c(0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00)) +
     scale_fill_manual(values = family2_scale$values, breaks = family2_scale$breaks, labels = family2_scale$labels) +
     theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 5),  # Legend text size
           legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm")) +
     guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 3, byrow = FALSE)) + # Legend columns, fill legend items by column
     labs(fill = "Family") + # Change legend label
     theme_custom_text()

legend <- get_legend(g)

ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-composition-0p01/Saliva-collection/Composition-saliva-legend.pdf"), plot = legend, device = "pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
```

#######################################
# ASV heatmap 10,000 read cutoff
#######################################

```{r ASV heatmap - by sample_origin}

for (sid in unique(samdf$Subject_ID)) {
  
  ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(Region == "Saliva" 
                                   & total_reads > 10000
                                   & Subject_ID == sid)

  taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
      filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT)
    
  ps2plot <- prune_taxa(taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot) %>%  # keep ASVs in taxa2keep
      transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # renomalize
    
  df2plot <- psmelt(ps2plot) # convert to long form
  df2plot <- set_ordered_factors(df2plot) # set ordered factors

  g <- ggplot(df2plot) +
       geom_tile(aes(x = interaction(Sample_origin2, Sample_ID), y = interaction(Feature, Taxon), fill = log10(Abundance))) +
       scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue", na.value = "black", limits = c(-3, 0)) +
       facet_nested(cols = vars(Collection_date, Collection_time), space = "free", scales = "free") +
       theme(strip.text.y = element_blank(),
             axis.title.x = element_blank(),
             axis.title.y = element_blank(),
             axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
             axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
             axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
             aspect.ratio = 1) +
       theme_custom_text()
    
    ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-ASV-heatmap-0p01/Saliva-collection/ASV-saliva-", sid, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 10, height = 0.15*(length(unique(df2plot$Feature))+3))
  
}
```

#######################################
# PCoA analyses 10,000 read cutoff
#######################################

```{r PCoA - by sample origin}

set.seed(100) # Consistent pcoa

for (region in c("Saliva", "Capscan", "Stool")) {
    
    ps2ordinate <- ps %>% subset_samples(Sample_origin3 == region 
                                         & total_reads > 10000) # Choose which samples you want to ordinate
    otu_table_ps <- otu_table(ps2ordinate)
    
    otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps[rowSums(otu_table_ps) > 0, ] # Remove rows with all zeros (empty OTU rows)
    otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps_clean[rowSums(otu_table_ps_clean > 0) >= 3, ] # Remove OTUs present in < 3 samples
    
    retained_otus <- taxa_names(otu_table_ps_clean)
    
    # Subset all components accordingly
    ps_clean <- merge_phyloseq(otu_table(otu_table_ps_clean),
                               sample_data(ps),
                               tax_table(ps)[retained_otus, ],
                               phy_tree(ps))
    
    ps_clean <- prune_taxa(retained_otus, ps_clean)
    
    for (d_metric in c("wunifrac", "unifrac", "bray", "canberra", "binary")) {
    
      pcoa_weighted <- ordinate(ps_clean, method = "MDS", distance = d_metric)
      ordination_data <- merge(pcoa_weighted$vectors, samdf, by = "row.names")
      var_exp <- get_evals(pcoa_weighted)$variance_exp # variances
  
      x_range <- range(ordination_data$Axis.1)
      y_range <- range(ordination_data$Axis.2)
      aspect_ratio <- diff(x_range) / diff(y_range)
      
      ordination_data <- set_ordered_factors(ordination_data) # set ordered factors
      
      lines_df <- ordination_data %>%
        filter(Region %in% region_order) %>%
        mutate(Region = factor(Region, levels = region_order)) %>%
        arrange(Sample_ID, Region)  # Ensures correct order within Kit_ID
      
      if (region == "Saliva") {
        colors2plot <- saliva_colors
      } 
      
      if (region == "Stool") {
        colors2plot <- stool_colors
      }
      
      if (region == "Capscan") {
        colors2plot <- capscan_colors
      } 
      
      g <- ggplot(ordination_data, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, fill = Sample_origin, shape = Region)) +
            scale_fill_manual(values = colors2plot)
  
           if (region == "Capscan") {
              g <- g +
                geom_path(data = lines_df, aes(group = Subject_ID), color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.6, lineend = "round")
            }
  
      g <- g + 
           geom_point(stroke = 0.5, color = "black") +
           scale_shape_manual(values = c("R1" = 21, "R2" = 22, "R3" = 23, "R4" = 24, "Saliva" = 21, "Stool" = 21)) +
           guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) + # Fill legend
           facet_wrap(~Subject_ID, ncol = 5) +
           force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(3, 3, 3, 3), "cm"), 
                           cols = unit(c(3, 3, 3, 3), "cm"), 
                           TRUE) +
           labs(title = d_metric,
                x = paste0("PCo1 ", round(var_exp[1],2), "%"),
                y = paste0("PCo2 ", round(var_exp[2],2), "%")) +
           coord_fixed(ratio = aspect_ratio)  # Force square axes
      
      ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-PCoA/", region, "/PCoA-", d_metric, "-", region, "-sample-origin.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 9, height = 7)
      
    }
}

```

```{r Total ASVs}

cutoffs <- c(0.01, 0.001, 0.0001)
nonzero_per_sample <- NULL

for (cutoff in cutoffs) {

  ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(total_reads > 10000)
  
  taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
        filter(Abundance > cutoff)
      
  ps2plot <- prune_taxa(taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot) %>%  # keep ASVs in taxa2keep
        transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) %>% # renormalize
        transform_sample_counts(function(x) {
          x[x < cutoff] <- 0
          x/sum(x)  # renormalize again so remaining abundances sum to 1
        })
  
    temp_counts <- psmelt(ps2plot) %>%
      filter(Abundance > 0) %>%
      group_by(Sample) %>%
      summarise(!!gsub("\\.", "p", paste0(cutoff * 100, "%")) := n())
  
  # Join to existing dataframe
  if (is.null(nonzero_per_sample)) {
    nonzero_per_sample <- temp_counts
  } else {
    nonzero_per_sample <- nonzero_per_sample %>%
      left_join(temp_counts, by = "Sample")
  }
}

nonzero_lf <- nonzero_per_sample %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Sample,
```

#######################################
# SharedASVs
#######################################

```{r Shared number of ASVs}

cutoffs <- c(0.01, 0.001, 0.0001)
results_list <- list()

for (cutoff in cutoffs) {
  
  # Filter and transform phyloseq object
  ps2plot <- ps %>%
    subset_samples(total_reads > 10000) %>%
    transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) %>%
    filter_taxa(function(x) any(x > cutoff), TRUE)
  
  # Get presence/absence of ASVs per sample
  df <- psmelt(ps2plot) %>%
    filter(Abundance > cutoff) %>%
    select(OTU, Sample, Subject_ID, Sample_origin3) %>%
    distinct()
  
  # Get ASVs per individual sample
  asv_by_sample <- df %>%
    group_by(Sample, Subject_ID, Sample_origin3) %>%
    summarise(ASVs = list(unique(OTU)), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Compare samples between different subject pairs, within same sample type
  shared_asvs <- asv_by_sample %>%
    group_by(Sample_origin3) %>%
    do({
      current_data <- .
      
      # Get all pairs of subjects (including both directions)
      subject_pairs <- expand.grid(
        idx1 = seq_len(nrow(current_data)),
        idx2 = seq_len(nrow(current_data)),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ) %>%
        filter(current_data$Subject_ID[idx1] != current_data$Subject_ID[idx2])  # Only different subjects
      
      subject_pairs %>%
        rowwise() %>%
        mutate(
          Subject1 = current_data$Subject_ID[idx1],
          Subject2 = current_data$Subject_ID[idx2],
          Sample1 = current_data$Sample[idx1],
          Sample2 = current_data$Sample[idx2],
          n_shared = length(intersect(
            current_data$ASVs[[idx1]], 
            current_data$ASVs[[idx2]]
          )),
          n_sample1 = length(current_data$ASVs[[idx1]]),
          n_sample2 = length(current_data$ASVs[[idx2]])
        ) %>%
        select(-idx1, -idx2)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(cutoff = gsub("\\.", "p", gsub("%", "", paste0(cutoff * 100, "%"))))
  
  results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- shared_asvs
}

# Combine all results
all_results <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Calculate average shared ASVs per subject pair
summary_by_subject_pair <- all_results %>%
  group_by(Subject1, Subject2, Sample_origin3, cutoff) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_shared = mean(n_shared),
    sd_shared = sd(n_shared),
    n_comparisons = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Overall summary by sample type and cutoff
overall_summary <- all_results %>%
  group_by(Sample_origin3, cutoff) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_shared = mean(n_shared),
    median_shared = median(n_shared),
    sd_shared = sd(n_shared),
    n_comparisons = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_by_subject_pair <- summary_by_subject_pair %>%
  mutate(Sample_origin3 = factor(Sample_origin3, levels = c("Saliva", "Capscan", "Stool"), ordered = TRUE))

g <- ggplot(summary_by_subject_pair, aes(x = Subject1, y = Subject2, fill = mean_shared)) +
      geom_tile(color = "black") +
      facet_grid(Sample_origin3 ~ cutoff) +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue", na.value = "black") +
      labs(title = "Shared ASVs Between All Subject Pairs",
           fill = "# Shared\nASVs") +
      coord_fixed() +  # Makes tiles square
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
            panel.background = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
            legend.frame = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),  # Black outline
            legend.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) + # Black ticks
     theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-Shared-ASVs/No/All-subjects.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 10, height = 9)

for (region in unique(samdf$Sample_origin3)) {
  for (cutoff_val in unique(all_results$cutoff)) {
    
    g <- ggplot(summary_by_subject_pair %>% filter(Sample_origin3 == region & cutoff == cutoff_val), aes(x = Subject1, y = Subject2, fill = mean_shared)) +
      geom_tile(color = "black") +
      facet_grid(Sample_origin3 ~ cutoff) +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue", na.value = "black", limits = c(0, NA)) +
      labs(title = "Shared ASVs Between All Subject Pairs",
           fill = "# Shared\nASVs") +
      coord_fixed() +  # Makes tiles square
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
            panel.background = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
            legend.frame = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),  # Black outline
            legend.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) + # Black ticks
     theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-Shared-ASVs/No/All-subjects-", region, "-", gsub("\\.", "p", gsub("%", "", cutoff_val)), ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 9, height = 7)
    
  }
}
```

```{r Shared abundance of ASVs}

cutoffs <- c(0.01, 0.001, 0.0001)
results_list <- list()

for (cutoff in cutoffs) {
  
  # Filter and transform phyloseq object
  ps2plot <- ps %>%
    subset_samples(total_reads > 10000) %>%
    transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))
  
  # Get abundance data
  df <- psmelt(ps2plot) %>%
    select(OTU, Sample, Subject_ID, Sample_origin3, Abundance)
  
  # Identify ASVs present above cutoff per sample
  asvs_above_cutoff <- df %>%
    filter(Abundance > cutoff) %>%
    select(Sample, Subject_ID, Sample_origin3, OTU) %>%
    distinct()
  
  # Get samples grouped by subject and sample type
  samples_by_subject <- df %>%
    select(Sample, Subject_ID, Sample_origin3) %>%
    distinct()
  
  # For each subject pair within same sample type
  shared_abundance <- samples_by_subject %>%
    group_by(Sample_origin3) %>%
    do({
      current_samples <- .
      
      # Get all pairs of subjects
      subject_pairs <- expand.grid(
        Subject1 = unique(current_samples$Subject_ID),
        Subject2 = unique(current_samples$Subject_ID),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ) %>%
        filter(Subject1 != Subject2)
      
      subject_pairs %>%
        rowwise() %>%
        do({
          s1 <- .$Subject1
          s2 <- .$Subject2
          samp_origin <- current_samples$Sample_origin3[1]
          
          # Get samples for each subject
          samples_s1 <- current_samples %>% filter(Subject_ID == s1) %>% pull(Sample)
          samples_s2 <- current_samples %>% filter(Subject_ID == s2) %>% pull(Sample)
          
          # Get ASVs present above cutoff in Subject1
          asvs_s1 <- asvs_above_cutoff %>%
            filter(Sample %in% samples_s1, Sample_origin3 == samp_origin) %>%
            pull(OTU) %>%
            unique()
          
          # Calculate total abundance of those ASVs in Subject2 samples
          # (regardless of whether they're above cutoff in Subject2)
          abundance_in_s2 <- df %>%
            filter(Sample %in% samples_s2, 
                   Sample_origin3 == samp_origin,
                   OTU %in% asvs_s1) %>%
            group_by(Sample) %>%
            summarise(total_abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")
          
          # Calculate average abundance across Subject2 samples
          avg_abundance <- ifelse(nrow(abundance_in_s2) > 0, 
                                  mean(abundance_in_s2$total_abundance), 
                                  0)
          
          data.frame(
            Subject1 = s1,
            Subject2 = s2,
            Sample_origin3 = samp_origin,
            n_asvs_subject1 = length(asvs_s1),
            avg_abundance_in_subject2 = avg_abundance,
            n_samples_subject2 = length(samples_s2)
          )
        }) %>%
        ungroup()
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(cutoff = gsub("\\.", "p", gsub("%", "", paste0(cutoff * 100, "%"))))
  
  results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- shared_abundance
}

# Combine all results
all_results <- bind_rows(results_list)

all_results <- all_results %>%
  mutate(Sample_origin3 = factor(Sample_origin3, levels = c("Saliva", "Capscan", "Stool"), ordered = TRUE))

g <- ggplot(all_results, aes(x = Subject1, y = Subject2, fill = 100*avg_abundance_in_subject2)) +
      geom_tile(color = "black") +
      facet_grid(Sample_origin3 ~ cutoff) +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue", na.value = "black", limits = c(0, 100)) +
      labs(title = "Percent shared ASVs between all subject pairs",
           fill = "% Shared\nASVs",
           x = "ASVs in Subject 1 at X cutoff",
           y = "% abundance of ASVs in Subject 2") +
      coord_fixed() +  # Makes tiles square
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
            panel.background = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
            legend.frame = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),  # Black outline
            legend.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) + # Black ticks
     theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-Shared-ASVs/Abundance/All-subjects.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 10, height = 9)

for (region in unique(samdf$Sample_origin3)) {
  for (cutoff_val in unique(all_results$cutoff)) {
    
    g <- ggplot(all_results %>% filter(Sample_origin3 == region & cutoff == cutoff_val), aes(x = Subject1, y = Subject2, fill = 100*avg_abundance_in_subject2)) +
      geom_tile(color = "black") +
      facet_grid(Sample_origin3 ~ cutoff) +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue", na.value = "black", limits = c(0, 100)) +
      labs(title = "Percent shared ASVs between all subject pairs",
           fill = "% Shared\nASVs",
           x = "ASVs in Subject 1 at X cutoff",
           y = "% abundance of ASVs in Subject 2") +
      coord_fixed() +  # Makes tiles square
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
            panel.background = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
            legend.frame = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),  # Black outline
            legend.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) + # Black ticks
     theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-Shared-ASVs/Abundance/All-subjects-", region, "-", gsub("\\.", "p", gsub("%", "", cutoff_val)), ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 9, height = 7)
    
  }
}
```

```{r ASV fluctuations 0p01 cutoff plot features}
  Feature = character(),
  Mean = numeric(),
  Color = character(),
  Variance = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (sample_origin in unique(samdf$Sample_origin3)) {
  
  for (sid in unique(samdf$Subject_ID)) {
    
    ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(Subject_ID == sid 
                                     & Sample_origin3 == sample_origin
                                     & total_reads > 10000)
    
    stringent_taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
      filter(Abundance > stringent_cutoff)
    
    ps2plot <- ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # normalize (NO PRUNING)
    ps2plot <- prune_taxa(stringent_taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot)
    
    df2plot <- psmelt(ps2plot) # convert to long form
    df2plot <- set_family_order(df2plot, taxa_order) # set Family2 order
    df2plot <- set_ordered_factors(df2plot) # set ordered factors
    
    # Plot all features in one figure
    
    g <- ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = interaction(Collection_time, Collection_date_reformat, Sample_ID), y = Abundance, group = Feature)) +
      geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = kit_colors) +
      scale_y_log10(limits = c(1e-7, 1), labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +  # set y-axis limits
      geom_point(aes(fill = Kit_set), size = 1, color = "black", shape = 21) +
      facet_wrap(~Feature, ncol = 12) +
      labs(x = "Collection time", y = "Abundance") +
      theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
            legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Legend text size
            legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")) +  # Size of the legend keys (symbol or color box)
      theme_custom_text() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
    
    ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-ASV-Fluctuation-0p01/", sid, "/ASV-fluctuation-", sid, "-", sample_origin, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 16, height = 8)
    
    # Individual features
    for (otu in unique(stringent_taxa2keep$Feature)) {
      df <- df2plot %>% filter(Feature == otu)
      
      g <- ggplot(df, aes(x = interaction(Collection_time, Collection_date_reformat, Sample_ID), y = Abundance, group = 1)) +
        geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = kit_colors) +
        scale_y_log10(limits = c(1e-7, 1), labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +  # set y-axis limits
        geom_point(aes(fill = Kit_set), size = 1, color = "black", shape = 21) +
        labs(title = paste0(otu, ": ", unique(df$Taxon)), x = "Collection time", y = "Abundance") +
        theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
              axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1), 
              axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
              legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Legend text size
              legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")) +  # Size of the legend keys (symbol or color box) 
        theme_custom_text()
      
      ggsave(paste0(directory ,"/Weeklong-ASV-Fluctuation-0p01/", sid, "/", sample_origin, "/", sample_origin, "-", otu, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 0.3*n_distinct(df$Sample_ID), height = 2) 
      # Create a row and append it
      new_row <- data.frame(
        Subject = sid,
        Color = unique(df$Color),
        Feature = otu,
        Mean = mean(df$Abundance),
        Variance = var(df$Abundance),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
        Sample_origin = sample_origin
      )
      ASV_fluctuation <- rbind(ASV_fluctuation, new_row)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r Calculate fluctuation variance}

for (sid in unique(samdf$Subject_ID)) {
  
  # Calculate slopes for each Sample_origin
  slopes <- ASV_fluctuation %>%
    filter(Subject == sid) %>%
    group_by(Sample_origin) %>%
    summarise(
      slope = coef(lm(log10(Variance) ~ log10(Mean)))[2],
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0("beta == ", round(slope, 2)))
  
  g <- ggplot(ASV_fluctuation %>% filter(Subject == sid), aes(x = Mean, y = Variance)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = Color), size = 2, shape = 21) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.2) +  # add best-fit line
    scale_y_log10(labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +
    scale_x_log10(limits = c(1e-4, 1), labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +
    facet_grid(cols = vars(Sample_origin)) +
    geom_text(data = slopes, aes(x = 5e-4, y = 5e-2, label = label), 
              hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "red", parse = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    coord_fixed() +
    labs(
      title = "Scatterplot of mean vs variance of each feature's relative abundance",
      x = "Mean relative abundance",
      y = "Relative abundance variance"
    ) +
    theme_custom_text()
  
  ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-ASV-Fluctuation-0p01/", sid, "/Mean-vs-var-", sid, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 6, height = 3)
}
```
